description: Extended scalar types keep their type INSIDE a variant container. Snowflake's VARIANT is a superset of JSON: a DATE, TIME, TIMESTAMP or BINARY placed in an OBJECT or ARRAY still reports its own type, where JSON alone could only carry the rendered text. Live-measured on the account: TYPEOF(OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('d', <date>):d) is DATE, ('t', <time>) is TIME, ('ts', <ts>) is TIMESTAMP_NTZ, ('b', <binary>) is BINARY, and ARRAY_CONSTRUCT(<binary>)[0] is BINARY - Frostlake reported VARCHAR for every one of them. The other half of the contract is that NOTHING about the text changes: the JSON rendering, ::VARCHAR, TO_JSON and OBJECT_KEYS must be exactly what they always were, because the type rides ALONGSIDE the text rather than re-encoding it. A variant PARSED FROM TEXT never had an extended type to keep, and live agrees that PARSE_JSON('{"b":"CAFE"}'):b is VARCHAR. Converted 1:1 from functions/VariantContainerTypedMembersTest (now retired).

steps.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT ENCRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY('CAFEBABE', 'HEX'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F', 'HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C', 'HEX')) AS o) SELECT TYPEOF(o:ciphertext) FROM e
WITH e AS (SELECT ENCRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY('CAFEBABE', 'HEX'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F', 'HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C', 'HEX')) AS o) SELECT TYPEOF(o:iv) FROM e
WITH e AS (SELECT ENCRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY('CAFEBABE', 'HEX'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F', 'HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C', 'HEX')) AS o) SELECT TYPEOF(o:tag) FROM e

WITH e AS (SELECT ENCRYPT_RAW(TO_BINARY('CAFEBABE', 'HEX'), TO_BINARY('000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F', 'HEX'), TO_BINARY('0102030405060708090A0B0C', 'HEX')) AS o) SELECT IFF(o:ciphertext::VARCHAR = TO_VARCHAR(AS_BINARY(o:ciphertext), 'HEX'), 'same', 'differ') FROM e
INSERT INTO vt SELECT OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('b', TO_BINARY('CAFE', 'HEX'), 'd', '2026-01-02'::DATE)
